```{r}
crime_change <- data.frame(
  category = c("Violent crime", "Burglaries", "Car thefts"),
  change_percent = c(-50, -48, -36)
)
arrests_by_year <- data.frame(
  year = c(2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025),
  arrests = c(734, 755, 800, 856, 1071, 1094)
)

```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
install.packages("janitor")
library(janitor)
```


```{r}
crime_change <- crime_change |> clean_names()
arrests_by_year <- arrests_by_year |> clean_names()
```
